description: China Natural Gas Pipelines (2013) is a Harvard Dataverse dataset by Lex Berman of the Center for Geographic Analysis at Harvard University. It gives an overview of the natural gas pipeline distribution system in China, generalised from plans, announcements and business reports and edited into a basic network map. The deposit holds a zipped shapefile of the pipelines, a PNG map and a PDF readme. It is free to download under CC0 1.0, dates from 2013 and was published in March 2017 without later updates. Coverage is national for China. Caveats: the geometry is a generalised sketch from secondary sources, not surveyed routes, it reflects plans as of 2013 so built status is not certain, and attributes are not described on the metadata page. Simulation uses are a coarse national gas transmission graph for network flow studies and for overlaying hazards on pipeline corridors. Related records: data-gem-global-gas-infrastructure-tracker gives newer project-level pipeline data including China.
